desc: Read the input $N$ and the sequence $A$, then compute the frequency array `cnt` where `cnt[x]` is the number of times $x$ appears in $A$.
Identify the distinct elements of $A$ to iterate over more efficiently than the full range $1 \dots 2 \cdot 10^7$.
Iterate through every odd integer $v$ from 1 up to $2 \times 10^7$ (the maximum possible sum).
For each odd $v$, iterate through multiples $S = v, 2v, 4v, \dots$ up to the maximum possible sum ($2 \times 10^7$).

For each multiple $S$, calculate the number of pairs $(i, j)$ with $i \le j$ such that $A_i + A_j = S$. This can be done by iterating over the distinct elements $x$ in $A$ and checking if $S-x$ exists in the frequency array.
Add $v \times (\text{count of pairs summing to } S)$ to `total_sum`.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Analyze time complexity on edge cases (e.g., all $A_i$ same, all $A_i$ distinct).
If TLE occurs, consider further optimizations like bitsets or FFT (though FFT is complex in pure Python).
